GM FIGHTIN’ 5TH![image]GREAT, GREAT NEWS FOR SANDWICH![image][image]The Town of Sandwich has been awarded an incredible $1,808,514 state grant for Phase 1 of the Sandwich Marina Harborwalk Master Plan![image][image]I was proud to advocate for this project and work with our state partners to help secure this important funding for Sandwich.[image][image]The Sandwich Marina is an incredible part of the 5th Barnstable District and one of the most beautiful and special places on Cape Cod.[image][image]This nearly $2 million in funding will help create an elevated, accessible boardwalk and improve the waterfront experience for residents, visitors, local businesses and families for generations to come.[image][image]This is one of the largest awards in this funding round anywhere in the Commonwealth, and we are so grateful for this significant investment in the Town of Sandwich.[image][image]A huge CONGRATULATIONS to the Town of Sandwich and a sincere thank you to Town Administrator Bud Dunham, Assistant Town Administrator Heather Harper, Harbormaster Nicholas Giordano, the Select Board Members, and everyone who worked so hard to make this project happen.[image][image]Special shout out to Engineer Cole Bateman of Tighe and Bond for spearheading this amazing, award-winning project.[image][image]I also want to thank Secretary of Economic Development Eric Paley, Secretary of Housing and Livable Communities Juana Matias, the Office of the Governor, and their respective offices and staff members for recognizing the importance of this project and making this significant investment in Sandwich.[image][image]What a great investment in Sandwich and our Cape Cod waterfront![image][image]Congratulations, Sandwich! This beautiful piece of our community will be even more special for generations to come.[image][image]We are grateful.[image][image]HAVE A TERRIFIC TUESDAY, EVERYONE![image]🇺🇸😊🛥️👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #Sandwich #SandwichMarina #OneStop #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]Town of Sandwich, MA[image]Sandwich Marina - Sandwich Harbormaster[image]Sandwich Chamber of Commerce[image]Tighe & Bond

GOOD MORNING & HAPPY CAPE COD MONDAY! [image]I’m proud to have the endorsement of the Massachusetts Parole Officers Association again this year.[image][image]The men and women of the MPOA do important work that sometimes doesn’t get the recognition it deserves. They play a vital role in public safety by supervising individuals released from incarceration, holding them accountable, and making sure the conditions of their parole are followed.[image][image]As a former police officer, I know how important accountability is. Public safety comes first, and our parole officers deserve our respect, our support, and the resources they need to do this difficult and sometimes dangerous job.[image][image]I’m proud to stand with them, have their backs, and have their endorsement.[image][image]Thank you to the Massachusetts Parole Officers Association for your support and for everything you do to keep our communities safe.[image][image]God bless our parole officers. Keep them safe. Keep them strong. GOOD MORNING, FIGHTIN’ 5TH![image]What a fantastic night in Marstons Mills![image][image]Thank you to the Marstons Mills Village Association for hosting last night’s monthly meeting at the beautiful Burgess House. There were so many great people, friends and neighbors coming together, staying informed and talking about the issues that matter to our community.[image][image]A special thank you to Kelly Collopy, DPW Communications Manager for the Comprehensive Wastewater Management Plan, and Griffin Beaudoin, Town Engineer, for an excellent and informative presentation.[image][image]The discussion about Barnstable’s comprehensive wastewater management plan was incredibly impressive. It is such an important issue for the future of our town, and Kelly and Griffin did a great job explaining the work being done and what it means for our communities.[image][image]A special thank you to President Debbie Lavoie for the great work she is doing, and to my longtime friend Commissioner Chris Lauzon, the Association’s secretary. You have a great organization and a great group of people.[image][image]I’m proud to support our Millbillies![image][image]It was also great to see my longtime friend and colleague, Barnstable County Delegate Frank Frederickson.[image][image]Great night. Great people. Great community.[image][image]As always, my office is here to help. If you have a question, concern or need assistance with a state issue, please reach out. The best way to contact my office is by email:[image][image]Steven.Xiarhos@MAHouse.gov[image][image]We are always here for you and will do our very best to help.[image][image]Have a wonderful Wednesday, everybody![image][image]God Bless[image]🇺🇸😊🫡[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #Barnstable #EnvironmentProtection #ProtectTheCape #MarstonsMills #Millbillies #CapeCod #Massachusetts[image]Town of Barnstable[image]Marstons Mills[image]Marstons Mills Village Association[image]Commissioner Christopher Lauzon[image]Frank Frederickson[image]Barnstable Clean Water Coalition[image]Barnstable Water Resources[image]Robert B. GREAT NEWS FOR THE FIGHTIN’ 5TH! [image]Additional Funding for Traffic Safety[image][image]Three of our local police departments are receiving grant funding to help with traffic safety and enforcement.[image][image]As a former police officer and Deputy Chief, I know firsthand how important these resources are to our local departments and the officers who serve our communities.[image][image]Targeted motor vehicle enforcement can make a real difference. It means getting impaired drivers off the road before they hurt or kill someone. It means addressing wrong-way drivers, dangerous speeding, unregistered and uninsured vehicles, distracted driving, and the many other violations that put innocent people at risk.[image][image]This extra enforcement helps make our roads safer for everyone, especially our families and children.[image][image]Congratulations to the Barnstable, Bourne and Sandwich Police Departments! Thank you for everything you do to keep our communities safe.[image][image]This is your tax dollars at work, supporting public safety right here at home.[image][image]Special thanks to the Office of the Governor, the Executive Office of Public Safety & Security, and the Office of Grants & Research.[image][image]God bless and protect our police officers.[image]🇺🇸💙🙏🏻🫡[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #BackTheBlue #PublicSafety #LawAndOrder #Barnstable #Bourne #Sandwich #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]Barnstable Police Department[image]Town of Barnstable[image]Town of Sandwich, MA[image]Sandwich Police Department[image]Bourne Police Department[image]Executive Office of Public Safety and Security

REST IN PEACE NURSE ELLEN[image]Today I had the honor of attending the beautiful funeral Mass for my friend and constituent, Ellen (Kelleher) Hanson, at Our Lady of Victory Church in Centerville.[image][image]Ellen was a truly special woman.[image][image]She was a fellow Cape Cod Community College graduate, a devoted mother, a compassionate registered nurse, and someone who spent her entire life caring for and serving others.[image][image]For 40 years, Ellen cared for people as a nurse, but her service went far beyond her profession. She gave her time, her heart, and her friendship to so many people and causes she believed in.[image][image]Most of all, Ellen was a mother. Her children, Scott, Kathleen, Sean, and Heather, were the center of her world. During her courageous battle with cancer, she fought fiercely for every extra moment she could have with them and the people she loved.[image][image]A lifetime of love, service, and sacrifice.[image][image]Brave. Strong. Kind.[image][image]Ellen taught us how to live life to the fullest every single day. She found joy in her family, her friends, the simple moments, and in making a difference in the lives of others.[image][image]Ellen is someone we all should strive to be like.[image][image]Her sense of humor, her strength, her love of family and friends, and her ability to find the good in every day will be remembered by so many.[image][image]I am grateful that I had the opportunity to know Ellen, to call her a friend, and to represent her as her State Representative.[image][image]To Scott, Kathleen, Sean, and Heather, and to all of Ellen’s family and friends, please know that your mom touched so many lives and leaves behind a beautiful legacy of love, service, and kindness.[image][image]Rest in peace, Ellen. Your life made a difference, and you will never be forgotten.[image]🇺🇸❤️🙏🏻🫡[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #GiveBack #Nurse #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]Cape Cod Healthcare[image]Our Lady of Victory Parish, Cape Cod, MA[image]Cape Cod Community College Alumni
